name: com.petsilence/noise
title: PetSilence
description: Classroom noise levels, setup steps, free vs Pro, and mic privacy for the PetSilence monitor.

tools.name: explain_noise_levels
tools.description: Explains how the PetSilence classroom noise monitor decides Quiet, Chatter and Too loud: its 0–100 relative sound scale, the thresholds for Silent Zone, Whisper Zone and Partner Talk, how calibration sets them, and what "too loud" means (and what it does to the focus timer). Optionally computes the thresholds for a mode and a calibrated room baseline. It cannot measure a room.

mode.description: silent = Silent Zone, whisper = Whisper Zone, partner = Partner Talk. Omit to get all three.

room_baseline.description: The room's calibrated background level on PetSilence's 0–100 scale (default 25, used before calibration).

tools.name: classroom_setup_steps
tools.description: Step-by-step setup of the free PetSilence noise monitor for an activity (silent reading, a test, a library or quiet room, partner work, group work): which sound mode to choose, how to calibrate, which focus goal and star reward to use, and a link to the app and the matching teacher guide.

goal_minutes.description: Optional focus goal in minutes. Free goals are 3, 5, 10 or 15; any whole minute from 1 to 60 needs Classroom Pro.

tools.name: free_vs_pro
tools.description: What is free in PetSilence and what Classroom Pro adds, with the real prices: school-year pass, lifetime, and a whole-school invoice. Includes refund and payment facts and a link to the Pro page.

tools.name: microphone_privacy
tools.description: Facts about how PetSilence uses the microphone and what it does and does not collect: on-device loudness only, no recording or upload, no student accounts, and which optional data (emails, farm backup, analytics) exists. For teachers, schools and IT reviewers.
